title: ROMA: The Open-Source Meta-Agent That Outperforms Deep Research

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Meet Roma. Recursive open meta agents. A groundbreaking open- source framework for building hierarchical high performance multi-agent systems. Think of it as the best open-source alternative to deep research. In fact, in benchmarks, Roma has outperformed closed source giants like Kim Researcher, Gro 4, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and Open AIO3 Pro. Here's how it works. Roma uses a recursive hierarchal structure to break down complex problems into paralyzable subtasks so agents can collaborate efficiently. And unlike blackbox systems, Roma is fully transparent. You can see every step making debugging and optimization far easier. It comes with specialized agents out of the box, a general purpose solver, a deep learning agent, and even a financial analysis agent. Setup is simple with a one-click install script or Docker container, and it's all open source under the MIT license, so you can use it commercially. If you're serious about building advanced AI workflows with clarity and performance, Roma is a project you need to explore. Check it out on GitHub link in the description.
